name: New Zealand
spiritual_teacher: Rare (Very far from global spiritual centers)
work_strategy: Remote (Due to cost of living and distance from Europe)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; then 10.5–39% PIT + ACC; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Temperate (Oceanic, mild, but often windy and changeable)
nature: Top Nature (Ocean on all sides, Southern Alps, incredible landscapes)
housing_rent: Extreme (One of the worst housing crises and highest price-to-income ratios)
mortgage_expats: Difficult (Ban on non-residents buying existing homes)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: International passport. Special Ukraine Visa requires a sponsor or relative in New Zealand.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Special Ukraine Visa for 2 years with a simplified pathway to permanent residency (Ukraine Residence Visa).
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: No state benefits — all financial support rests on the sponsor or own funds.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: No state-provided housing; private rent or sponsor's accommodation (500–600 NZD/week).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Free primary health advice via Healthline. Access to public healthcare on par with citizens; ACC accident insurance.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: No concessions; a personal car is needed due to weak public transit.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Full work rights on the special visa; average wage from 21.20 NZD/hr.
